changes: BEND's box is as large as the destination boxes beside it, in the same lettering.

Preset names edit as on the stock SAVE PROJECT AS screen: hold an arrow and it repeats, FUNC + NO deletes the letter before the cursor, FUNC + YES inserts a space and the cursor stays on its letter, and the cursor can move past the end of the name.
Holding UP or DOWN scrolls the preset lists.
LOAD PROJECT > CREATE NEW now starts the new project with the default presets (SELECT DEFAULT, or the factory settings) on every track, instead of keeping the last project's EXPRESSION settings.

TRIG works on the EXPRESSION page as a page key does on the stock pages: held, the knobs show their values in place of their labels (V.SNS and the depths, as stock shows VEL and LEN), and letting go after that keeps the page; a quick tap still goes back.
On the TRIG page, a hold of TRIG that shows the stock values no longer opens the EXPRESSION page when you let go.

BEND turns finely, as a depth does (2.50 semitones, shown 2.5 in its box); FUNC + turn snaps it to every whole semitone, OFF, 1, 2 ... 12. Files write it as BEND=2.50; older files' BEND=5 still reads as 5 semitones.
Preset menu: the LEVEL knob moves through the lists one step a detent, through the firmware's own accelerator, as the LFO page's DEST list.
Names: letting go of FUNC writes the picked letter and moves on to the next place, as the stock naming screen, so FUNC, pick, let go types a name letter by letter.
MIDI tracks: a value switched off on its page (FUNC + its knob, such as SRC MW or a CC VAL slot) no longer keeps its last value under the live input: the mod wheel runs from 0 again.
Preset menu: FUNC's release always reaches the Digitakt (a FUNC key could stick); the trig keys' releases too.
Preset menu: a push of any knob works as YES; the LEVEL knob moves one step a turn; SRC, FLTR, AMP, LFO and the other page and menu keys leave the menu and do their own job.
Opening the menu: a small twist of knob A while it is held no longer cancels it.

Names: the character being edited is inverted, measured with the font's own widths; holding FUNC shows the letter grid of the stock naming screen (FUNC + arrows pick, letting go of FUNC writes the letter).
Titles: [SND] or [MIDI] Expr. presets; RESET TO DEFAULT and SELECT DEFAULT.

Settings are text files on the +Drive, one per project slot (/cfw/expression/projects/003.txt, the project's name inside), so renaming a project or deleting another keeps them; no limit on the number of projects.

Every file is written to /cfw/expression/_temp first and then in its place; a file that is cut short or broken is skipped for its copy, then the defaults. Values out of range in a hand-edited file are held to the nearest valid one.

Presets: a 1-second push of knob A opens LOAD, SAVE, RESET and DEFAULT. 64 audio-track and 64 MIDI-track presets, named as SAVE PROJECT AS names a project; DEFAULT picks the preset new projects and RESET start from (Factory: the mod's own defaults).
The settings at power-on are written only when nothing has played for 2 seconds, so a write never lands in a performance.
Smaller: about 10 KB less RAM for the page and the files' code.
Known issue: saving, presets and the MIDI LFO destinations are not yet tested on a unit.

Each track's EXPRESSION settings are saved with the project: SAVE PROJECT AS stores them under the project's name, LOAD PROJECT brings them back, and at power-on they come back as they were. Kept in /cfw/expression.a and .b on the +Drive (32 projects).
A MIDI track's CCs go through the firmware's own CC append, so FX Track sees them.
Checked to link with every other Modwerk Digitakt module except Digi Perform.
Known issue: saving and the MIDI LFO destinations are not yet tested on a unit.
MIDI tracks: MW, VEL and AT can move the track's own LFO: LFO:Speed, Multiplier, Fade, Start Phase and Depth, at the end of the destination list.
The list shows a CC VAL slot as "CC:CC2 VAL #74" ("Value" left no room for the number's second digit).
Known issue: the LFO destinations are not yet tested on a unit.

Until a MIDI track has sent a value itself, live input adds to the track's parameter as set (SRC AT, MW, BC; FLTR CC VAL 1-8), not to 0: stock sends a value only when it changes, so after power-on the mod did not know it. Pitch bend too (its parameter is 14-bit, 8192 at the centre).

While live input is aimed at a value, an unchanged value is no longer sent again each time the track resends it (its LFO calls send() every pass): on a unit, CC 1 went out about every 7 ms with the LFO on MW. Changes and forced sends still go out at once.

Fixes the freeze on a unit with live input to MIDI tracks: the mod no longer sends MIDI itself. It hands what it has to the MIDI tracks' own task, which sends it with its normal output (CC buffer, after the sequencer's), so nothing waits on the DIN driver from the MIDI input or the UI.
Live pass-through on MIDI tracks reaches MIDI OUT within about a millisecond in the emulator; a velocity route goes into the notes buffer just before its note.
Sends where OUTPUT TO says (MIDI and/or USB), as the track's own values go.
Known issue: the MIDI-track side is not yet tested on a unit.
MIDI tracks get the same page as audio tracks: knob A THRU (PB, AT, MW and now BC on or off), V.SNS, and MW, VEL and AT routes with depths.
MIDI destinations are the MIDI LFO page's: PB, AT, MW, BC and CC VAL 1-8 (on their SEL's CC number, shown in the list and box).
Everything aimed at one value adds up with the track's own (knob, locks, LFO) and goes out as one message.
Values on the same CC number (MW and a slot on SEL 1, BC and SEL 2, two slots on one SEL) are merged into one CC: the latest own value plus everything live.
Breath (CC 2) from MIDI IN passes with THRU.
MW> and AT> are gone: route the wheel or pressure to a CC VAL slot instead.
The sequencer now records the velocity as played; V.SNS applies to what plays, live or from the sequencer, and can be changed afterwards.
VEL as a modulation source follows every note the track plays, sequencer trigs included, and stays when another track is selected.
MIDI tracks: V.SNS applies to the notes they send, live or from the sequencer.
Under the hood: the velocity hook moved from the note router to the render's note store (audio) and the MIDI tracks' note output.
Pushing the knob whose destination list is open closes the list, as on the stock pages.
Depths (M.DEP, V.DEP, A.DEP) are as fine as the LFO page's DEP: -64.00 to +64.00.
FUNC + turn now jumps between useful values, as FUNC + TUNE jumps octaves: depths in 16s, BEND 1/2/3/5/7/12, V.SNS in 25 %, destinations page by page, CCs in tens.
Depths start at 0; V.SNS at 100 %.
SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU, MW THRU removed: each track's own switches do the job, and the mod works from power-on without ticking anything.
Known issue: settings are not saved.
The EXPRESSION page now looks like the stock FLTR and LFO pages: eight knob cells under the TRIG page's header, track box and LEV meter.
Knobs use the firmware's own acceleration, as the stock pages do; FUNC + turn puts a cell back to its default.
Turning MW, VEL or AT opens a destination list like the LFO page's DEST.
New: VEL as a modulation source (VEL DEST, V.DEP) on audio tracks.
New: V.SNS per track: how much the played velocity counts, for the sound and for what is recorded (100 % as played, 0 % every note full).
Fixed: LFO destinations (speed, multiplier, fade, phase, depth) now work; they are added before the LFO stage. FLTR slot 37, which the engine never reads, is no longer offered.
Known issue: settings are not saved. Not yet tested on a unit beyond 0.4.
New: the TRIG page's second page (tap TRIG on the TRIG page) holds each track's own settings.
Audio tracks: BEND RANGE, MW DEST, MW AMOUNT, AT DEST and AT AMOUNT per track, on knobs A-E.
MIDI tracks: PITCH BEND, AFTERTOUCH and MOD WHEEL on or off per track; MW AS and AT AS send the wheel or the pressure on a CC of your choice.
SETTINGS keeps only PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU.
Not built together with Digi Perform, which opens its page with the same gesture.
Known issue: the per-track settings are not saved; they return to their defaults at power-on. Not yet tested on a unit.
Audio tracks: pitch bend moves the track's pitch by up to PB RANGE semitones (default 2).
MW DEST and AT DEST send the mod wheel and aftertouch to a parameter of the track's sound, by MW AMT and AT AMT.
Everything adds to the track's own value and LFOs, within the parameter's range; changing track stops it.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
Pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel now add to the MIDI track's own value (its knob, parameter locks and LFO), capped to the MIDI limits.
A held bend no longer jumps back when the track sends its own value.
Selecting another track gives the previous synth back the track's own values; the new track follows only when you next move a control.
Unticking a row gives the track its own value back.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
First release for Digitakt I OS 1.54, on Core 2.1. SETTINGS > PB THRU, AT THRU and MW THRU pass pitch bend, aftertouch and the mod wheel from MIDI IN to the synth a MIDI track plays.
They follow the notes: the AUTO CHANNEL to the active MIDI track, a TRACK CHANNEL to that track, sent on the track's CHAN.
Sequencer notes and controls go out first. DIN MIDI OUT only. Unticked, MIDI is stock.
The settings are not saved and start unticked at every power-on.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
